s.id,s.owner_scope,s.enterprise_id,s.resource_id,s.user_code,s.sandbox_type,s.sandbox_id, s.profile_key,s.status,s.create_time,s.last_access_time,s.lock_version, u.user_name,e.com_acct_name AS enterprise_name, () AS current_record, (u.state='A' AND UPPER(COALESCE(u.is_locked,'N'))!='Y' AND (u.user_exp_date IS NULL OR u.user_exp_date>CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)) AS user_active
